definitions.explanation: The act of making corrections or adjustments to fix errors or improve accuracy. Used in technical, budgetary, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {補正|ほせい}{予算|よさん}が{国会|こっかい}で{可決|かけつ}された。
examples.english: The supplementary budget was passed in the Diet.

examples.japanese: カメラの{露出|ろしゅつ}{補正|ほせい}を{調整|ちょうせい}して、{写真|しゃしん}の{明|あか}るさを{変|か}えた。
examples.english: I adjusted the camera's exposure compensation to change the brightness of the photo.

notes: Very common in several domains. In government: {補正|ほせい}{予算|よさん} (supplementary budget — an additional budget passed after the initial annual budget). In photography: {露出|ろしゅつ}{補正|ほせい} (exposure compensation). In fashion/undergarments: {補正|ほせい}{下着|したぎ} (shapewear, corrective underwear). In data: データの{補正|ほせい} (data correction). Different from {修正|しゅうせい} (correction/amendment), which implies fixing something wrong; {補正|ほせい} emphasizes supplementing or adjusting to improve.
